items.description: Author-created gene network schematic for presenting Start regulation, linked by its author to the Cln3 article. This is a specific budding-yeast mechanism diagram, not a generic human gene network or an inferred experimental network.
items.scope_notes: Candidate pending actual cloud-render review. Named yeast relationships must not be relabeled as human mechanisms. It may supply an editable example of activation/inhibition network structure, but it is not a blank generic component and is not automatically a match for every gene-network request. The 2011 mechanistic content is not claimed to be a current exhaustive scientific model.
